Name: Krobus' Room into Kris' Deltarune Room
Author: nolioblivisci
Description: Ever wondered why even after you invite Krobus to live with you he decides to stick to his sewer room design? Why doesn't he ever try something else? With this mod you can gift your shadow friend (or perphaps something more?) the coziness of a fairy tale room, masterfully (trivially) cropped right from Deltarune made by Toby Fox. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI. Simply unpack it under Stardew Valley/Mods, launch via SMAPI and play!

Manifest.Name: Deltarune Krobus' Room
Manifest.Description: Turns Krobus' room into Kris' Dark World room from Deltarune
